title: Stratifying Hospital Readmission Penalties by Community Social Vulnerability: reproducible analysis code and public input data
description: Reproducible analysis pipeline and public input data for a budget-neutral simulation of Medicare's Hospital Readmissions Reduction Program (HRRP). A single Jupyter notebook reproduces CMS's FY2026 payment-adjustment factor from public data (validation MAE 0.00016; r = 0.99) and recomputes penalties under CDC/ATSDR Social Vulnerability Index (SVI) peer grouping, holding total penalty dollars fixed ($368.4M), quantifying the reallocation ($14.1M; 3.8%) with county-clustered inference and bootstrap confidence intervals. Bundled inputs are U.S. Government / public-domain CMS and CDC/ATSDR files; the Area Deprivation Index (Neighborhood Atlas) is excluded because its terms restrict redistribution (obtain it via free registration; the notebook treats it as an optional sensitivity).
